about_short_description.short_description: careCycle is an AI workforce for Medicare agencies and FMOs, supporting top agencies in their operations.

product.name: Retention Suite
product.description: An AI-driven system that automates member engagement and support to improve retention for Medicare agencies by providing personalized welcome calls, benefit reminders, and 24/7 member care.

product.name: Revenue Suite
product.description: A system that engages existing Medicare members to cross-sell ancillary products and secure Annual Enrollment Period renewals through personalized, automated outreach.

product.name: Sales Suite
product.description: An AI-powered lead management system that pre-screens and qualifies Medicare prospects, providing warm transfers and appointment scheduling to licensed agents 24/7.
